data.name: Anmika
data.long_meaning: Anmika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Anu’ meaning ‘towards’ and ‘Mika’ meaning ‘goddess’. This name signifies the graceful presence of a goddess moving towards someone. It is believed that this name was given to a goddess who came to the aid of a devotee in his time of need.
